sources.title: Argentina: Decree 261/2011 on passports (updated text)
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official legal text gives Argentine citizens the right to the ordinary Argentine passport for foreign travel and distinguishes it from refugee, stateless, exceptional-foreigner, diplomatic, official and special documents.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Todos los ciudadanos argentinos tienen derecho a obtener el Pasaporte Ordinario para Argentinos.

sources.title: Bosnia and Herzegovina FIPA: visa information for visitors
sources.publisher: Foreign Investment Promotion Agency of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current Foreign Investment Promotion Agency page is published on the Council of Ministers' gov.ba domain and lists Argentina among citizens who do not require a visa.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Citizens of the following countries do not require a visa to enter Bosnia and Herzegovina: ... Argentina.

sources.title: Service for Foreigners' Affairs: stay of aliens in Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.publisher: Service for Foreigners' Affairs of Bosnia and Herzegovina
sources.officialityEvidence: The current competent Service for Foreigners' Affairs guidance says the Decision on Visas determines the visa-free country list and states the statutory visa-free stay limit.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Visa-free aliens may enter and stay up to 90 days over a six-month period.

sources.title: Embassy of Argentina in Tunisia: tourist entry information
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Argentine Republic in Tunisia
sources.officialityEvidence: The current official Argentine Embassy in Tunisia visitor page directly states the tourist entry treatment of Argentine passport holders and the maximum stay.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Los portadores de pasaportes argentinos no requieren visa ... hasta por 90 días.

sources.title: Nigeria Immigration Service: 2026 Tourism (F5A) visa service level
sources.officialityEvidence: Nigeria Immigration Service's April 2026 service-level document defines the F5A online tourism process and emailed certificate. Its Appendix I directly lists Argentina's paid single-entry and other visa fees, resolving that Argentina is not in the waiver exception.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea Government: online visa portal announcement
sources.publisher: Government of the Republic of Equatorial Guinea Information and Press Office
sources.officialityEvidence: The Government Information and Press Office's institutional page identifies the exact equatorialguinea-evisa.com domain as the portal for obtaining a visa online.
sources.supportingExcerpt: se puede obtener online el visado ... accediendo a la página https://equatorialguinea-evisa.com.

sources.title: Equatorial Guinea eVisa: live English service text
sources.officialityEvidence: The exact domain is authenticated by the Government announcement. This live service asset was last modified 30 July 2026 and supplies the nationality scope, regular-passport limitation, online application, and emailed/PDF issuance mechanics.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All Nationalities can apply for an E-Visa. The only travel document is a regular passport. All E-Visas are sent by email.

policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Bosnia and Herzegovina short-visit visa exemption
policies.summary: Current Bosnia and Herzegovina government guidance lists Argentina in the general visa-free rule and states an up-to-90-days-in-180-days stay limit.
conditions: Use an ordinary Argentine passport, not a diplomatic, official, special, refugee, stateless or exceptional-foreigner document. Current BiH government guidance lists Argentina as visa-exempt and sets the general visa-free stay at up to 90 days in 180 days.
This does not establish employment, residence, carrier rules or final admission.

policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Tunisia tourist visa exemption
policies.summary: Argentina's current Embassy in Tunisia guidance says Argentine passport holders do not need a visa for a tourist stay of up to 90 days.
conditions: Use an ordinary Argentine passport for a tourist visit of up to 90 days. The Embassy's guidance does not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, special, refugee, stateless, exceptional-foreigner, carrier or final-admission treatment.
Comply with current destination border, health and passport-validity requirements.

policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Nigeria tourism eVisa
policies.summary: Nigeria Immigration Service's current F5A tourism route includes Argentina, requires online application, and sends the tourism visa certificate by email before travel.
conditions: Appendix I of Nigeria Immigration Service's current service-level agreement directly lists paid Argentine single-entry, multiple-entry, TWP and STR visa fees. Together with the F5A all-country rule, this establishes that Argentina is not among the visa-waiver exceptions.
Apply online with a valid ordinary Argentine passport and F5A tourism documents. The visa is single entry, valid for 90 days from issuance, and permits a stay of up to 30 days.

The emailed visa certificate is electronic issuance before travel, not online preapproval followed by border issuance. Diplomatic, official, special, refugee, stateless and exceptional-foreigner documents, work, residence, carrier rules and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Nigeria Immigration Service eVisa application
steps: Apply online with the ordinary Argentine passport and stated tourism documents.
Pay and receive the visa certificate by email before departure.
Present the certificate and supporting documents for carrier and final-admission checks.

policies.title: Argentine ordinary passports: Equatorial Guinea electronic visitor visa
policies.summary: Equatorial Guinea's Government-authenticated live eVisa service accepts all nationalities using a regular passport and sends the eVisa by email as a PDF before travel.
conditions: The current service asset says all nationalities can apply for an eVisa. Use the same ordinary Argentine passport for application and travel; it states that only a regular passport is accepted and other travel documents are not eligible.

Apply online through the Government-authenticated VFS eVisa service. The current service asset says the eVisa is sent by email and available as a PDF download before travel; this is electronic issuance, not an arrival-issued visa.
The ordinary visitor route does not establish work, residence, diplomatic, official, special, refugee, stateless, exceptional-foreigner, carrier or final-admission entitlement.

application.label: Equatorial Guinea eVisa application (VFS)
steps: Apply online using the ordinary Argentine passport for travel.
Receive and retain the emailed PDF eVisa before departure.
Present the same passport and eVisa at arrival for immigration processing and final admission.
